title: Sex Selection of Human Spermatozoa
summary: This study aims to demonstrate a reliable method of selecting gender specific sperm. X-bearing spermatozoa and Y-bearing spermatozoa will be identified from the density gradient layers. The selected gender specimen will then be utilized for assisted reproductive fertilization- in vitro fertilization or intrauterine insemination which are routine standard of care procedures.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Couples undergoing infertility treatment with IVF or insemination seeking gender specific offspring for medical and non medical reasons

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe male factor
sponsor: Weill Medical College of Cornell University
